summary: Frontend-only testing for 3 new features (Price Lists, Category Custom Fields, Party Merge). All 7 requested flows verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL. No frontend bugs found. Zero console errors during flows.
verified_flows: Price Lists page (/admin/price-lists): existing seeded row renders (Ramesh Traders / Jyoti Potato / Sale / ₹550.00 / Per Bag / Active). Add modal opens with Party, Product, Rate Type (Sale/Purchase), Agreed Rate, Rate Basis, Valid From, Notes, Status fields. Edit/Delete actions present.

Sales auto-fill: new Sale + Ramesh Traders + Jyoti Potato -> Rate field auto-filled to '550' and toast 'Rate filled from price list' displayed. Custom fields section (Cold Storage Rent / Grading) rendered inside modal.

Categories page: 'Cold Store Potato' edit modal shows Custom Fields editor with 2 rows -> [Cold Storage Rent, Number] and [Grading, Text]; +Add Field repeater present; table shows custom-field badges.

Purchases custom fields save: created NEW purchase with category 'Cold Store Potato', filled purchases-custom-cold_storage_rent=120 and purchases-custom-grading='A grade'. Save returned 'Created successfully' toast and PUR-00002 row appeared in the list.

Party Merge (/admin/party-merge): duplicate-groups section shown with 2 Ramesh Traders parties. Clicked merge, confirmation dialog opened, 'Merge & keep one' succeeded with toast 'Parties merged. All history moved to the kept party.' After reload the group vanished and 'no-duplicates' state appeared. Manual merge card with source/target selects + Merge button is also present.

RBAC: created a fresh Operator staff account (op<ts>@demo.com). After operator login, sidebar hides 'Merge Parties' but shows 'Price Lists'. Direct navigation to /admin/party-merge shows 'Access restricted' guard.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /admin/users list shows the owner (whose sidebar badge is ADMIN) with a role of 'Operator' in the table. This is inconsistent labeling; user rows may be showing membership role separate from the owner flag. Cosmetic, not blocking.
Minor: In Purchases list, PUR-00002 created without a date shows 'DATE: -' since Date field defaulted empty in the Add modal. Consider defaulting today's date.
test_credentials: Owner: merge_test_1788760554@demo.com / Owner@123. Operator: freshly created each run via /admin/users -> Add Staff.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 new purchase (PUR-00002) with custom fields and 1 new operator staff account for RBAC test. Consumed the duplicate Ramesh Traders group via merge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The seeded duplicate party group has been merged, and a purchase (PUR-00002) with custom fields exists. Re-runs won't find duplicates unless main agent re-seeds; the 'no-duplicates' path is the expected state now.
